topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: Isn't it something, how the world turns? I bumped into Jamie today, or at least, I thought it was Jamie. Same smile, same way of pushing their hair behind their ear. But they didn’t remember me, not a bit! I found myself laughing about it, telling stories from when we were kids as if inviting them to a party they hadn’t realized they were missing. And you know what? I felt like I was at the best party ever, just talking about those old times. It didn’t matter that Jamie didn’t recall; I just kept the stories flowing, and it was like we were building new memories right there, laughing together like we used to.
